verdict.rationale: Linear ships an official TypeScript SDK that exposes its GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations, and it can be used in any JavaScript environment. The SDK sits on a well-documented GraphQL API that supports schema introspection, and the schema is published in the official repo. Missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript/JavaScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK itself (community reports cover the raw GraphQL API only).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Linear Typescript SDK exposes the Linear GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations.
Install the Linear SDK to use strongly typed models and operations
It’s written in Typescript but can also be used in any Javascript environment.
